# Fluent System Icons

Copyright Microsoft Corporation. Licensed under the MIT license in LICENSE.

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-system-icons/tree/9eb184e96268d3293462f9d9d19225b4c7b07774

The normalized Regular 16px and 20px SVG paths used by Navora are stored in shared/ui-icon-assets.ts. Missing 16px assets use the official 20px asset. The selected radio control uses the official Filled radio_button 16px/20px assets from the same source commit; its central dot distinguishes it from the unchecked Regular circle. Colors follow currentColor; geometry is preserved.

Navora's workspace expand/restore pair, R2 attach icon, workspace count control and legacy minimize stroke are local drawings and are not claimed as Fluent assets.
